{{Top|leg}}
'''Berko-8''' was a cleaning product. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] recommended rinsing out [[Droid/Legends|droid]] lubrication containers with Berko-8 if it was being pressed into service as a [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] canister.
